Download and get started

Start from source; no downloads are invented.

A truthful installation path for the environment the project currently supports.

There is no release binary yet

PEACOCK does not currently publish installers, signed packages or a version manager. Use the source repository and the Python bootstrap.

Before you start

A few important boundaries for a first-time user.

Can I compile PEACOCK without Python?

Not yet. The Python bootstrap remains required to compile, run, build and test PEACOCK programs.

Does PEACOCK use a GPU or train frontier models?

No. The verified engine is CPU-only and intended for small models and tests.
